purpose: Redesign and test Signalbot's internal hypothesis-DISCOVERY process, upstream of the heavy MARKET-0X confirmatory lifecycle (ARM/claim/one-shot/RESULT). This is a research-process unit, not a market hypothesis: it defines how candidate mechanisms get cheaply screened before any of them is allowed to become a preregistered, confirmatory MARKET-0N experiment.
this_unit_is_not: a preregistration of R-A or any other region
new generic infrastructure unrelated to a concrete research blocker

program_pivot.reason: Signalbot has strong falsification/validation machinery (frozen preregistration, ARM/claim/one-shot execution, sealed RESULT, red-team hardening) but INTERNAL_PROMISING_PROTOTYPES = 0. Every internally-generated MARKET hypothesis executed so far (MARKET-01, 02, 05, 06) returned NO_EVIDENCE at the confirmatory stage. MARKET-03 is an EXTERNAL public-strategy reproduction and must not be counted as internal discovery. The evidence therefore does not support routing R-A directly into another single confirmatory attempt; it supports first testing whether the internal discovery/generation process itself can produce a promising prototype at all, across several orthogonal mechanism regions at once, before committing further confirmatory-lifecycle cost to any one of them.

supersession_of_a711086_routing.statement: Commit a711086 remains the valid, unmodified historical record of the orthogonal-region selection (REGION_SELECTED = R-A, SELECTION_STATUS = REGION_SELECTED_NOT_HYPOTHESIS_CREATED). This unit does not merge, rebase, or edit that commit. It supersedes only the ROUTING that followed from it (NEXT_UNIT = STRUCTURAL_REGIME_STATE_DETECTION_MECHANISM_CLASS_AND_NULL_MODEL_FEASIBILITY), by recording a later, separate program-level decision in a new commit.

r_b_r_f_fresh_surface_correction.original_statement_in_a711086: R-B and R-F need a fresh evaluation surface that does not exist ('R-B ... requires a genuinely fresh evaluation surface. The 2020-2024 surface is historically exposed/adapted...'; R-F 'shares R-B's fresh-surface problem').
r_b_r_f_fresh_surface_correction.scope_correction: That statement is CORRECT but was written without distinguishing discovery from confirmatory use, and is hereby scoped to CONFIRMATORY use only. It was true, and remains true, that neither R-B nor R-F has an unexposed surface available for a CONFIRMATORY claim of independent evidence. It does NOT follow that R-B or R-F cannot be explored at all: cheap, outcome-inspecting, non-evidentiary ADAPTIVE DISCOVERY on historically exposed 2020-2024 data is explicitly permitted for both, under the constraints below.
r_b_r_f_fresh_surface_correction.discovery_feasibility_vs_confirmatory_fe: DISCOVERY_FEASIBILITY != CONFIRMATORY_FEASIBILITY. DISCOVERY_FEASIBILITY asks only whether a mechanism class can be cheaply screened for a non-trivial pattern using data already exposed to prior program adaptation, with outcome inspection allowed and no evidentiary claim implied. CONFIRMATORY_FEASIBILITY asks whether a materially fresh, non-adapted, outcome-blind surface exists to test that pattern as independent evidence. R-B may be explored under DISCOVERY_FEASIBILITY on the 2020-2024 exposed surface (see DISCOVERY_SPRINT_01 card D2); any resulting pattern remains exploratory and requires an independent future confirmation surface before it can support a MARKET-0N claim. R-F may be explored under DISCOVERY_FEASIBILITY only under a tightly bounded, pre-frozen search surface (see card D5), with its HIGH rescue/multiple-testing risk explicitly carried forward, not laundered away by relabelling it 'discovery'.

1_ADAPTIVE_DISCOVERY.definition: Cheap, outcome-inspecting exploration of a candidate mechanism class on historically exposed 2020-2024 research data. Outcomes MAY be inspected during construction and iteration.
1_ADAPTIVE_DISCOVERY.governance: A Discovery Card (see discovery_card_contract) must exist before any code is written for a mechanism class. No ARM, claim, reservation, or one-shot execution authority applies at this stage.

2_PROMISING_PROTOTYPE.definition: A discovery result that survives the Promising Prototype Gate (see promising_prototype_gate). It is a discovery-stage filter outcome, not confirmatory evidence, and does not by itself authorize a MARKET-0N preregistration.
2_PROMISING_PROTOTYPE.what_it_authorizes: Eligibility to be proposed as a future confirmatory hypothesis. Proposal is a separate, later program-level decision, requiring its own information-gain and feasibility review exactly like MARKET_NEXT_HYPOTHESIS_SELECTION_FROM_ORTHOGONAL_REGIONS.
what_it_does_not_authorize: creating MARKET-07 or any MARKET-0N id directly from this unit
skipping preregistration, ARM/claim/one-shot execution, or sealed RESULT for the eventual confirmatory test

3_CONFIRMATORY_RESEARCH.definition: The existing, unchanged heavy MARKET-0X lifecycle: frozen preregistration, outcome-blind analysis contract, point-in-time data feasibility check, ARM/reservation/claim authority chain, one-shot canonical execution, sealed RESULT. Requires a materially fresh or explicitly-accounted-for surface per CONFIRMATORY_FEASIBILITY.
3_CONFIRMATORY_RESEARCH.relationship_to_discovery: A PROMISING_PROTOTYPE is at most a candidate INPUT to a future confirmatory preregistration decision. It carries no evidentiary weight of its own and must not be cited as support inside a confirmatory RESULT.

fields.MECHANISM_CLASS: The class of structural mechanism being screened (e.g. discrete state detection, tail filtering, path morphology).
fields.INFORMATION_SOURCE: What data/observable the card draws on (e.g. CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0 price path, CORE_ETH price path, externally published strategy).
fields.FUNCTION: The analytical function performed: detection, filtering, characterization, relative comparison, composition, or benchmark reproduction. Never 'prediction' unless the card is explicitly a scalar-prediction screen.
fields.TARGET_FAMILY: The broad family of what a positive result would look like, without committing to a frozen confirmatory metric.
fields.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: How (if at all) the mechanism could plausibly relate to a future tradable edge, stated conservatively.
fields.SIMPLE_BASELINE: The trivial/naive comparator the discovery result must beat to be interesting at all.
fields.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: The explicit, small, pre-stated set of variants/parameters allowed to be tried, to bound researcher degrees of freedom.
fields.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: What prior program work has already touched this data/mechanism combination (adaptive and/or confirmatory), citing the relevant units.
fields.WHAT_A_NULL_DEPRIORITIZES: What a NO_USEFUL_STRUCTURE result would mean was tried and found wanting, i.e. the information-gain payoff of a negative result.
fields.WHAT_A_POSITIVE_WOULD_JUSTIFY_NEXT: What a PROMISING_PROTOTYPE would make it reasonable to propose next (never 'immediate MARKET-0N creation').
fields.RESEARCHER_DOF: Explicit statement of researcher degrees of freedom risk (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH) and its source.
fields.MAX_ENGINEERING_SCOPE: An explicit cap on how much implementation work this card may consume before it must report a terminal state.

requires: no lookahead / as-of semantics preserved even during discovery
an explicit statement of the attempted search surface
reporting of ALL attempted variants, not only the best one

promising_prototype_gate.purpose: A discovery filter, not confirmatory evidence. Decides only whether a pattern is worth proposing for a future confirmatory test.
disqualifiers: one magic cell (single parameter/year/split combination that happens to work)
one isolated year driving the entire effect
negligible practical magnitude even if statistically suggestive
leakage or mechanical artifact (lookahead, label leakage, boundary bug)
the product of a large hidden search surface beyond SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE
considerations: practical magnitude: is the effect size large enough to matter before costs/frictions, not just distinguishable from zero
neighborhood/parameter stability where relevant: does the pattern survive small, pre-stated perturbations of the construction, or is it a knife-edge
temporal/regime consistency: does the pattern show up across more than one sub-period rather than only in a favorable regime
simple baseline/control comparison: does it beat the SIMPLE_BASELINE and a naive negative control
adequate support: enough independent observations/effective N, not a handful of overlapping events
absence of obvious artifact: no boundary/leakage/mechanical explanation found on inspection

program_diagnostic.market_03_classification: MARKET-03 belongs only to EXTERNAL evidence/history. It must never be counted toward INTERNAL_DISCOVERY_CARDS or INTERNAL_PROMISING_PROTOTYPES.
program_diagnostic.usage_rule: These counters are diagnostic, not a formal success-probability comparison. They inform a program-level decision; they are not themselves a statistical test.
program_diagnostic.stall_rule: After 6-10 materially orthogonal INTERNAL discovery cards, if INTERNAL_PROMISING_PROTOTYPES == 0, record INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS_GENERATION_NOT_DEMONSTRATED = true and require an explicit program-level decision before continuing another discovery batch. The correct response to that flag is NOT to generate another cluster of nearby variants.

information_gain_rule: Each new discovery card must either (A) produce a PROMISING_PROTOTYPE worth future confirmation, or (B) materially reduce priority for a distinct mechanism-space region by returning NO_USEFUL_STRUCTURE on a genuinely different mechanism class. Cards whose null would teach essentially nothing about mechanism-space coverage must not be created.
cross_sectional_sidecar_note: DISCOVERY_SPRINT_01 additionally records one outcome-blind feasibility sidecar, CROSS_SECTIONAL_PANEL_FEASIBILITY. It is explicitly NOT one of the six discovery cards and computes no signal/outcome statistics.
